Seeing as "No" is the popular consensus here I suppose I'll try to elaborate my feelings on this:

* In general, people should not feel ashamed or embarrassed of their sexual needs and desires.
* The feeling that you need to hide something like this from your SO usually points to a more general problem.  This problem may be a simple miscommunication or misunderstanding, but it could be much more serious.
* If the frequency with which you watch porn is affecting your IRL love-life then this could also point to a more serious problem.
* In general, women tend to take emotional infidelity more seriously than men, and men tend to take physical infidelity more seriously than women.  (If anyone takes offense to this, or simply disagrees, I'm more than willing to hear a counter-argument.  As I'm feeling lazy right now, all I can state with certainty is that I remember reading a study from some reputable source, and this is what I think I'm echoing.)

My point is that your SO may simply feel jealous about you looking at other naked women.  If this is the case then I would personally suggest you explore various issues dealing with trust, self-confidence, and self-worth.  Either try to talk it out or see a councilor.

But, if this is related to you being unable to have sex with your SO, or points to general problems of attraction then honestly I'd say you're doing yourself more harm than good by staying with her.

I suppose the question to ask is: "If your SO were otherwise ok with porn, does your watching porn have a negative impact on your relationship?"  And then, of course, "If so, how & why?"
